package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	listener, err := net.ListenTCP("tcp", &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 9000})
	must(err)
	defer listener.Close()
	client, err := net.DialTCP("tcp", nil, listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr))
	must(err)
	defer client.Close()
	server, err := listener.AcceptTCP()
	must(err)
	defer server.Close()
	_, err = client.Write([]byte("retained network"))
	must(err)
	must(client.CloseWrite())
	data, err := io.ReadAll(server)
	must(err)
	if string(data) != "retained network" {
		panic("network bytes differ")
	}
	fmt.Println(string(data))
}
